verdict.rationale: A community report credits React with exposing interfaces for building custom renderers, which positions React as a declarative API for almost any platform. First-party material confirms the component model already targets non-DOM platforms (server rendering, native mobile via React Native). However, the first-party docs never describe a custom-renderer API or how to write one. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the renderer/reconciler interface, a documented guide or example for authoring a custom renderer, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write custom renderers so the framework's component model can target platforms other than the browser DOM

citations.quote: building custom renderers through React's exposed interfaces
React can also render on the server using Node and power mobile apps using React Native.
React Native and Expo let you build apps in React for Android, iOS, and more.
